# Client branding profile - <Client Name>

Copy this file to `clients/<client-slug>.md` when capturing a new client's profile (see client-branding.md for the capture-once workflow). Delete rows that don't apply; unknowns stay listed as "not captured" so gaps are visible.

- **Client name / preferred short name:** not captured
- **What they call the project/program:** not captured
- **What they call the system** (e.g. "Workday", an internal brand name): not captured
- **Logo usage rules** (when the firm may use their logo, files location): not captured
- **Mandated fonts/colors for docs:** not captured
- **Email sign-off convention:** not captured
- **Document header/footer requirements** (confidentiality footers etc.): not captured
- **Terminology preferences / glossary:** not captured
- **Distribution norms** (who is cc'd on status, who receives escalations): not captured
- **Source artifacts reviewed** (paths to the client emails/docs this profile was derived from): not captured
